dedupeText: mid century duo album cover vintage duo stairs slab serif cobalt blue sepia tone mid century modern vertical division between organic photographic texture and flat geometric color block contrast between the warm sepia earth tones of the image and the cool cobalt blue sidebar typographic alignment following the vertical axis of the sidebar and the horizontal header combine a desaturated grainy environmental portrait with a high saturation geometric sidebar and high contrast condensed slab serif typography for a classic 1960s editorial look

recipe.visualDefinition: A split-composition album cover featuring a grainy, warm-toned photograph of a man and woman on a stone staircase, paired with a solid vertical blue sidebar containing high-contrast typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical division between organic photographic texture and flat geometric color block
Contrast between the warm sepia/earth tones of the image and the cool cobalt blue sidebar
Typographic alignment following the vertical axis of the sidebar and the horizontal header
coreInvariants: Stone staircase as a central diagonal element
Solid blue vertical column on the right third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two figures positioned centrally and slightly left, occupying the middle ground of the stone staircase.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The solid blue vertical sidebar on the right edge acts as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left title, follow the diagonal of the stairs down to the subjects, then move right to the blue sidebar and down the tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The textured wall behind the subjects provides breathing room for the white header text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cobalt blue in the vertical sidebar.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm sepia, ochre, and stone greys in the photograph.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright orange-red for the primary artist names.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blue and orange elements contrasts with the muted, desaturated tones of the film photography.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy vertical strokes with thin horizontal serifs
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ampersand is stylized and condensed to match the width of the letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic typeface family used in different colors and scales to distinguish hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast slab serif look with condensed proportions.
Captures the extreme condensation and heavy slab serifs typical of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a grainy, 1960s-style film photograph of a man in a brown jacket and a woman in a dark suit sitting on an old stone staircase inside a rustic building. Add a solid cobalt blue vertical bar covering the right 25% of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add extra-condensed slab serif text in white at the top left. Add the same font style in orange-red at the top of the blue bar, and in white for a list of items further down the blue bar.

verificationChecks: Is the right sidebar a solid, flat blue?
Is the photo texture grainy and warm-toned?
Are the fonts extra-condensed slab serifs?
Is the main title white and placed over the image?

adjustableVariables: Color of the accent text (orange vs yellow)
mustRedesign: Exact wording of the titles and tracklist
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not bleed into the subjects' faces.
Check that the blue sidebar is perfectly vertical.
Verify the slab serifs are sharp and not rounded.
Confirm the photo looks like a scanned physical print.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a desaturated, grainy environmental portrait with a high-saturation geometric sidebar and high-contrast condensed slab-serif typography for a classic 1960s editorial look.
